airportSteps: Arrive at the airport with extra time. Customs confirmation cannot be rushed.

Complete customs confirmation before you check your baggage with the airline and before security. Keep all tax-free goods with you, including perfume packed in a suitcase; checked bags cannot be retrieved for this procedure.

Present your passport at a tax-free procedure kiosk or electronic terminal. At Narita, Haneda, Kansai, Chubu, Fukuoka, New Chitose and Naha airports, Visit Japan Web is an alternative in designated international-departure lobby areas connected to the procedure-specific wireless LAN before security.
Follow the result: green means no inspection is required and customs confirmation is complete; red means you must take the goods to the customs inspection area and complete inspection.

Complete customs confirmation within 90 days of purchase and before boarding procedures. For a domestic-to-international connection, use your final departure airport from Japan. Export the confirmed goods without delay.

After customs confirmation, receive the refund from the store or its refund operator under the terms given at purchase. Refund methods, timing and any fees vary; an immediate cash refund at the airport is not guaranteed.

faq.q: When does the Japan tax-free system change?
faq.a: The refund method starts for purchases made from 1 November 2026. Purchases made through 31 October 2026 follow the current procedure.

faq.q: Do I pay consumption tax at the store?
faq.a: Under the current procedure through 31 October 2026, eligible purchases are exempted at the store. From 1 November 2026, travelers pay the tax-inclusive price first and receive a refund later.

faq.q: Where do I get the refund?
faq.a: After customs confirmation, the store or its refund operator provides the refund. Methods, timing and any handling fees vary. Confirm the terms at purchase; an immediate cash refund at the airport is not guaranteed.
Fragrance is treated as a consumable through 31 October 2026. From 1 November 2026, the distinction between general goods and consumables and the ¥500,000 consumables cap are removed.

faq.q: What happens if I use the product in Japan?
faq.a: From 1 November 2026, if you consume all or part of the perfume in Japan, you cannot receive customs confirmation or a refund. Do not use a tax-free procedure terminal; tell a customs officer. A missing item also prevents a refund for the other tax-free items on the same receipt.

faq.q: What does the 90-day deadline apply to?
faq.a: For purchases from 1 November 2026, complete customs confirmation at departure within 90 days of purchase, then export the goods without delay. This is not a deadline for receiving the refund. Eligibility also depends on your visitor status; confirm it with the store.

faq.q: Can I use Visit Japan Web at every airport?
faq.a: No. It is available for this procedure at Narita, Haneda, Kansai, Chubu, Fukuoka, New Chitose and Naha, in designated international-departure lobby areas connected to the procedure-specific wireless LAN before security. Online users must have Temporary Visitor, Diplomat or Official status of residence; Japanese nationals cannot use this online procedure. Follow the official terminal instructions if you cannot use the online route.

faq.q: What if one item on a receipt is missing?
faq.a: Customs confirmation is performed per purchase transaction (receipt). If you do not have even one tax-free item included in that transaction, none of its items can receive customs confirmation or a refund. Keep every item together and available for inspection.

faq.q: Is tax-free the same as duty-free?
faq.a: No. Tax-free stores in the city refund Japan's consumption tax. Duty-free shops at the airport relate to customs duty and to taxes on items such as alcohol and tobacco. Sillage covers the former.

consumablesExportPledge.note: NTA guidance refers to a pledge, made at purchase, to export consumables within 30 days without opening the designated packaging. Some other official pages omit this figure.
